findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.citation_text:
3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

Two cans in dry storage were observed with significant dents in the upper seam. The PC was shown and education conducted. The cans were discarded to correct. Ensure that the integrity of packaging of all foods are maintained in the facility at all times. If damaged packaging is received return that package or refuse receiving.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the dish machine would not register sanitizer on the inspector’s test strips. Investigation revealed an empty jug of sanitizer concentrate attached to the machine. The jug was replaced with a fresh jug and primed by the inspector and staff. Afterwards the machine registered correct amounts of sanitizer. Ensure that all sanitizers are maintained at effective concentrations at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.12(B) Cleaning Procedure. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use the following cleaning procedure in the order stated to clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms, including surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms: (1) Rinse under clean, running warm water; (2) Apply an amount of cleaning compound recommended by the cleaning compound manufacturer; (3) Rub together vigorously for at least 10 to 15 seconds while: (a) Paying particular attention to removing soil from underneath the fingernails during the cleaning procedure, and (b) Creating friction on the surfaces of the hands and arms or surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms, finger tips, and areas between the fingers; (4) Thoroughly rinse under clean, running warm water; and (5) Immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying using a method as specified under § 6-301.12.

A food handler is observed to wash their hands and then use their bare hands to turn off the faucet. The PIC was notified and instructed to review hand washing with staff to ensure safe hand washing moving forward. Education conducted to correct. Ensure that all hand washing is completed in a safe manner at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: The PIC during this inspection could not produce their CFPM certification. Education was conducted and they are aware that they need to maintain proof at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: On arrival the sani buckets in the kitchen registered low on inspector test strips. The last they were changed was during breakfast. The buckets were remade during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment: Two sani rags are stored on a tray  next to the prep counter in the middle of the kitchen. This is the standard practice. Education was conducted and the rags placed into bucket of sanitizer to correct. This will be the standard practice moving forward.
